comments.comment: With nearly 1000 comments, you've probably already been made aware, but at 13:02, you accidentally added $200 to the monthly cashflow. I'm glad you put out there to at least break even, but for people starting out, they should avoid negative to break even cashflows, in my opinion. I think others suggest no less than $400/month positive cashflow (which would obviously obey your suggestion). Doing what seems to be your favorite, and is definitely one of my favorite strategies, fix and hold, it is easier to find cash flow properties in L.A. and other high priced metros.
